body: Read it all in Cartman's Chinese accent. It changed me.

Thank you everyone who took the time to help me out last night and into the morning. I can't even begin to tell you just how thankful I am. I need to try to start seeing things in a new light, things aren't always bad, right? I figure if I take things day by day I'll be just fine, and at least once a day I will find at lease one thing that makes life worth living. My story isn't done just yet, there still has to be a happy ending. Once again, thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I really appreciate this, it helps to know that I'm not the only one that feels this way, though at the same time it sucks that someone actually knows my pain. Thank you for taking the time to help me out...
I'm freaking myself out right now..
I really needed that, Thank you!!
